verdict.rationale: Stable documents a nationwide registered agent service. Its API lets you add a registered agent Location to your existing Organization, so a company can receive service of process and state correspondence in a given jurisdiction alongside its CMRA mailbox locations. The evidence does not show how this is bundled with or priced as an add-on to a mailbox plan; the pricing page lists only mailbox features. missing for 10: documented bundling/add-on pricing of registered agent with mailbox plans, detail on how service-of-process documents are handled and delivered, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get registered agent service tied to the same account — service-of-process handling bundled with or added to my mailbox plan

citations.quote: Learn how to add a new registered agent Location to your existing Organization so a company can receive service of process and state correspondence in a given jurisdiction.
Stable helps businesses stay compliant with a nationwide registered agent service that centralizes mail management and automates filings.
An IATA-style code (e.g. `SFO1`) creates a CMRA. A 2-letter state code (e.g. `WY`) creates a registered agent location.
